The '''C223 Para 3''' is a smaller version of the extremely popular Paramilitary 2. It should be noted that the "3" refers to the blade length and is actually part of the model name, not a designation of what generation the knife is on.

==History, mentionings from the forums etc.==
Spyderco forum discussion about the [http://forum.spyderco.com/viewtopic.php?f=2&t=72081 "Paramilitary3"].

For more background and information on the C223 Para 3, also see the article in the [[Spyderco byte - December 2016]] Newsletter

==Information from the Spyderco catalog on the web==

C223 Para 3:

"''The Para 3 takes all the proven features and benefits of Spyderco’s best-selling Para Military™2 and distills them into an even more compact all-purpose cutting tool. Its three-inch blade is precision machined from premium CPM® S30V® particle metallurgy stainless steel and features a full-flat grind for a superior balance of strength, point utility, and low-friction cutting performance. It includes a textured index-finger choil and thumb ramp that provide a solid purchase for a forward grip and offer enhanced control during precise cutting tasks. The blade’s signature Trademark Round Hole™ clearly brands it as a member of the Spyderco family and is fully accessible to allow quick, positive, one-handed opening with either hand.''

''To keep the Para 3 slim and pocket friendly, it features a lightweight, open-backed construction style and its stainless steel liners are nested into machined recesses in the textured G-10 scales. This reduces the handle thickness and provides excellent structural support for the knife’s patented Compression Lock™. Located in the spine of the handle, this high-strength mechanism locks the blade securely open during use, yet allows it to be closed easily and safely with only one hand. A four-position hourglass clip and an oversized lined lanyard hole complete the design, offering ambidextrous tip-up or tip-down carry and allowing the easy attachment of fobs and lanyards.''

''Ounce for once one of the most capable folding knives ever made, the Para 3 is destined to be a classic.''"

The C223 Para 3 in [http://www.spyderco.com/catalog/details/C223G/Para-3/1009 Spyderco's online catalog]

==Variations==

The C223 Para 3 is made in Golden, CO and has
* [[Compression Lock]]
* Nested stainless steel liners
* Open-backed construction
* Lanyard hole

==Most collectible variation==

===Questions regarding collecting the C223===

Some interesting questions we are looking for an answer to:

Questions with an answer: '''Q:''' Is the Para 3 the same as a Paramilitary 3? '''A:''' No. While the C81 Paramilitary is sometimes shortened to "Para" by fans online, the C81 Paramilitary and the C223 Para 3 are two different models. To add to the confusion, there was a batch of C223's with the incorrect label of "Paramilitary 3" on the boxes, but [https://forum.spyderco.com/viewtopic.php?p=1322686&sid=fb52c925a0aa06358d85e1ca30cfb8ef#p1322686 this was an error]. The "3" in Para 3 refers to the blade length and is part of the model name, so the "3" does not signify its generational status. As to what a second generation Para 3 would be called, we can't say. But if a third generation Paramilitary comes out (Paramilitary 3), the "Para" shorthand for the C81 will have to be dropped, as "Para 3" is already taken.
